topic.title: More tips for visiting parisian bookshops
topic.shortdesc: General advice for your bookshop tour.

body.note: Some shops only accept cash or French debit cards.
Always check the shop's website for temporary closures.
Watch your belongings in busy areas like the Latin Quarter.
Make sure you've got everything you need: comfortable shoes, one or two stylish and sturdy bags, and a bottle of water.
We recommend following the itinerary on a weekday and setting off from Place de la Concorde at 2 pm.
Most bookshops are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
